review_items.rationale: Reviewed Claim C-notify-identity v1, fixed plan and exact harness bytes for artifact 7b63c5fa750747b29543e17e6b7da0d2, and raw CheckRun d6c6f213390745ee9884b2c7b71b96c1. Applicability: append_notify promises its entry's decided index; Superseded is expressly a conservative error, not permission for an unrelated successful result. The runtime assigns accepted_after, an exclusive boundary; first entry maps returned 1 to core position 0. Entry content, not just index/count, is compared. History: empty three-node cores first complete genuine ballot-1 Prepare/Promise/AcceptSync. The exact node-1 instance is moved into the actor. The only notification call proposes 101; both emitted AcceptDecide packets containing 101 are dropped by the node-1 partition, while nodes 2/3 remain empty. Public try_become_leader on node 2 generates ballot 2; the trace records node-3 promise and acceptance, then 202 at boundary 1 is decided by nodes 2/3. Caller reconnect callbacks generate PrepareReq, Prepare, Promise and AcceptSync; received synchronization carries decided=1, sync_idx=0 and suffix [202]. No target state or message is fabricated. Draining sender buffers preserves remaining per-link ordering; the partition routing label TRACE route is an attempted route and the fixed conditional explicitly drops destination 1 during isolation. Origin actor commands verify actual installation [202], so mere enqueue/sync_seen is not used alone as completion. Identity: one task owns one future; admission and result both use independent scenario=replacement, operation=notify-A, not the compared value or changed ballot. The monitor selects admission explicitly. Admission is emitted after real acceptance and before replacement; the result is emitted only after joining the original future. Observed ok=true, returned_index=1, actual_value=202 and admission requested_value=101 make the implication false. Reads occur through actor-owned commands while the actor is live and no later application proposals exist. The post-result decided suffix confirms content independently of expectation. No missing result, parse error, or correlation ambiguity is present. Cause evidence: drain_notifiers success branch ignores stored ballot and precedes Superseded; incoming dispatch processes Prepare/AcceptSync without notification until a tick. Thus the measured history exercises the original discriminator rather than an easier substitute. Failure analysis: stderr points solely to fixed harness line 167, actor shutdown Elapsed, after the result event at line 163 and handle drops at 164-165. It is not a target panic, unfulfilled admission, missing operation completion or unreliable shutdown-state read. The cleanup event was not emitted and normal actor shutdown is NOT established. This independently bounded lifecycle observation does not reverse an already-returned success or decided value, so the complete identity witness survives the nonzero process exit.

limitations: One unbatched, uncompacted, local-origin append_notify in a fixed three-node configuration with MemoryStorage, no restart.
Finite explicit leadership transition via public API and real timer interval; no deadline violation or global progress proof.
Does not establish all runtime notification variants or overall core consensus unsafety.
Actor shutdown did not complete in the two-second post-observation wait; cleanup ownership and closed-stream selection need separate investigation.
